title: FSD ↔ reference page links and findings (contract trace-links v3, Phases 2b, 2c)
description: specs/trace.yaml (D58), read as JSON. v2 added the requirement a link belongs to (D99). v3 adds what a finding carries (D118): its permanent id, its severity and who set it, and its evidence, each record checked by EvidenceValidator; files written by v1 and v2 still read. One entry per link or finding: both ends, the state, both quotes and their hashes, and the decision people make. decided_by comes from git, never typed.

requirement.description: The requirement this link judges, when the section's requirements were built (D99).

by.description: judge: the link judge proposed it (and, for agree, a second fresh check confirmed or disputed it); code: found by code.

decided_on.description: The hash of the page statement's normalised text when the decision was made, written by code. If the text changes, the decision drops back. No input hash reads it.

finding.description: Permanent, issued by trace check from specs/trace-ids.json. Only a finding has one.

severity.description: A person sets it, in a PR. Starts ungraded. See Severity in Core.

severity_by.description: Comes from git after merge, as decided_by does; never typed.

evidence.description: Records of contract evidence v1, derived again by trace check from what's current. Nobody types them.

evidence_hash.description: The hash of the evidence as code last wrote it, so a record that differs is told apart from one that's only out of date.
